command:
set -eu
cat > /srv/legacy2/mail-spool-deduplication/bin/replay <<'REPLAY_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
spool=$base/spool
delivered=$base/delivered
quarantine=$base/quarantine
index=$delivered/index.tsv
lock=$base/.replay.lock

tmp=
cleanup() {
    [ -z "$tmp" ] || rm -f -- "$tmp"
    rmdir -- "$lock" 2>/dev/null || :
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

if ! mkdir -- "$lock" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf '%s\n' 'replay: another recovery run is active' >&2
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p -- "$delivered" "$quarantine"
if [ ! -e "$index" ]; then
    printf 'message_id\tfile\n' > "$index"
fi

recovered=0
skipped=0
quarantined=0

for message in "$spool"/*.eml; do
    [ -e "$message" ] || continue

    id_count=$(awk '
        BEGIN { count = 0 }
        /^\r?$/ { exit }
        tolower(substr($0, 1, 11)) == "message-id:" { count++ }
        END { print count }
    ' "$message")

    message_id=$(awk '
        /^\r?$/ { exit }
        tolower(substr($0, 1, 11)) == "message-id:" {
            line = $0
            sub(/\r$/, "", line)
            sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/, "", line)
            sub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", line)
            print line
            exit
        }
    ' "$message")

    reason=
    if [ "$id_count" -eq 0 ]; then
        reason='missing Message-ID header'
    elif [ "$id_count" -gt 1 ]; then
        reason='multiple Message-ID headers'
    elif ! printf '%s\n' "$message_id" | awk 'BEGIN { ok = 0 } /^<[^<>[:space:]]+>$/ { ok = 1 } END { exit !ok }'; then
        reason='invalid Message-ID header'
    fi

    if [ -n "$reason" ]; then
        name=${message##*/}
        qfile=$quarantine/$name
        if [ -e "$qfile" ] && ! cmp -s -- "$message" "$qfile"; then
            n=1
            while [ -e "$qfile.$n" ]; do n=$((n + 1)); done
            qfile=$qfile.$n
        fi
        cp -p -- "$message" "$qfile"
        printf '%s\n' "$reason" > "$qfile.reason.txt"
        printf 'quarantined\t%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$reason"
        quarantined=$((quarantined + 1))
        continue
    fi

    if awk -F '\t' -v id="$message_id" 'NR > 1 && $1 == id { found = 1 } END { exit !found }' "$index"; then
        printf 'skipped\t%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "${message##*/}"
        skipped=$((skipped + 1))
        continue
    fi

    name=${message##*/}
    destination=$delivered/$name
    if [ -e "$destination" ]; then
        stem=$name
        suffix=
        case "$name" in
            *.eml) stem=${name%.eml}; suffix=.eml ;;
        esac
        n=1
        while [ -e "$delivered/$stem.$n$suffix" ]; do n=$((n + 1)); done
        destination=$delivered/$stem.$n$suffix
    fi

    tmp=$(mktemp "$delivered/.replay.XXXXXX")
    cp -p -- "$message" "$tmp"
    mv -- "$tmp" "$destination"
    tmp=
    if ! printf '%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "${destination##*/}" >> "$index"; then
        rm -f -- "$destination"
        exit 1
    fi
    printf 'recovered\t%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "${destination##*/}"
    recovered=$((recovered + 1))
done

printf 'summary\trecovered=%s\tskipped=%s\tquarantined=%s\n' "$recovered" "$skipped" "$quarantined"
REPLAY_EOF
